steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFP.
Apply a questionnaire template to the RFP.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the required technical questionnaire content.
Assign the evaluator required for a technical event.

args.goal: on the buyer's single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", verify both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the two clauses and make them mandatory, which no dedicated catalog step can express.
Invite one QA vendor to the event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's technical questionnaire as the vendor.
Verify the first mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Fill the technical response so the submission attempt is not blocked by unanswered questionnaire fields.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Verify the vendor cannot submit while the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
